Tomato___Bacterial_spot.en:
**Tomato Bacterial Spot**

**What it is:** Bacteria (Xanthomonas species), spread by rain splash, tools and infected seed.

**Signs:** Small dark, water-soaked spots on leaves, often with a yellow edge; raised scabby spots on fruit.

**Do now:**
1. Remove badly spotted leaves and take them out of the field.
2. Do not work among plants while they are wet.
3. Clean tools and hands between rows.

**Prevention:**
1. Use certified clean seed or seedlings.
2. Rotate away from tomato and pepper for 2-3 seasons.
3. Avoid overhead watering; use drip or water at the base.

**If you spray:** Copper-based bactericides (e.g. copper hydroxide), often mixed with mancozeb, slow the spread. They protect new growth; they do not cure spotted leaves.

**Organic options:** Copper products allowed in organic farming, plus strict sanitation.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** If spots appear on most plants or on the fruit, bring a sample to the MAO.

_Check against: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Vegetable MD Online - Cornell University (vegetablemdonline.ppath.cornell.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.tl:
**Bacterial Spot sa Kamatis**

**Ano ito:** Bacteria (Xanthomonas), kumakalat sa talsik ng ulan, gamit, at may sakit na binhi.

**Sintomas:** Maliliit na maitim at mukhang basa na batik sa dahon, minsan may dilaw na gilid; magaspang na batik sa bunga.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Tanggalin ang dahong maraming batik at ilabas sa bukid.
2. Huwag galawin ang halaman habang basa.
3. Linisin ang gamit at kamay bago lumipat ng hanay.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Gumamit ng certified na binhi o punla.
2. Huwag magtanim ng kamatis o sili sa parehong lugar sa loob ng 2-3 season.
3. Iwasan ang pagdidilig mula sa itaas.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Copper-based na bactericide (hal. copper hydroxide), madalas may halong mancozeb, para mapabagal ang pagkalat. Proteksyon ito sa bagong dahon, hindi gamot sa may batik na.

**Organic na paraan:** Copper na puwede sa organic, at laging linisin ang taniman.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** Kung karamihan ng halaman o ang bunga ay may batik na, magdala ng sample sa MAO.

_Sources: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Vegetable MD Online - Cornell University (vegetablemdonline.ppath.cornell.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_

Tomato___Early_blight.en:
**Tomato Early Blight**

**What it is:** Fungus (Alternaria species); survives on old plant debris and spreads in warm, humid weather.

**Signs:** Brown spots with rings like a target, starting on the lowest, oldest leaves, which then yellow.

**Do now:**
1. Strip the lower spotted leaves and remove them from the field.
2. Mulch the soil so rain does not splash spores up.

**Prevention:**
1. Rotate away from tomato, potato and eggplant for 2-3 seasons.
2. Plough under or remove crop debris after harvest.
3. Keep plants well fed - stressed plants get it worse.

**If you spray:** Protectant fungicides with mancozeb or chlorothalonil; systemic options include azoxystrobin or difenoconazole. Alternate groups so the fungus does not become resistant.

**Organic options:** Copper fungicides and Bacillus subtilis products give partial protection; sanitation matters most.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** If it climbs past the middle of the plants within a week, ask the MAO.

_Check against: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Penn State Extension - vegetable and field crop disease fact sheets (extension.psu.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Tomato___Early_blight.tl:
**Early Blight sa Kamatis**

**Ano ito:** Fungus (Alternaria); nabubuhay sa lumang tira ng halaman at kumakalat kapag mainit at humid.

**Sintomas:** Brown na batik na may bilog-bilog na parang target, nagsisimula sa pinakamababang dahon na naninilaw.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Tanggalin ang mga may batik na dahon sa ibaba at ilabas sa bukid.
2. Lagyan ng mulch ang lupa para hindi tumalsik ang spores.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Huwag magtanim ng kamatis, patatas o talong sa parehong lugar sa loob ng 2-3 season.
2. Ibaon o alisin ang tira ng pananim pagkatapos mag-ani.
3. Lagyan ng tamang abono - mas tinatamaan ang mahinang halaman.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Fungicide na may mancozeb o chlorothalonil; may systemic din gaya ng azoxystrobin o difenoconazole. Magpalit-palit ng grupo para hindi masanay ang fungus.

**Organic na paraan:** Copper at mga produktong may Bacillus subtilis ay may bahagyang proteksyon; pinakamahalaga ang kalinisan.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** Kung umakyat na lampas kalahati ng halaman sa loob ng isang linggo, magtanong sa MAO.

_Sources: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Penn State Extension - vegetable and field crop disease fact sheets (extension.psu.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_

Tomato___Late_blight.en:
**Tomato Late Blight**

**What it is:** Water mould (Phytophthora infestans). Spreads very fast in cool, wet weather and can kill a field in days.

**Signs:** Large, greasy grey-green to dark brown patches; white fuzz on the underside in humid mornings; firm brown rot on fruit.

**Do now:**
1. Act today: pull out and bag badly affected plants - do not compost them.
2. Protect the healthy plants around them with a fungicide right away.
3. Warn neighbouring farms; spores travel on the wind.

**Prevention:**
1. Plant resistant varieties where available.
2. Do not plant tomato next to potato.
3. Spray protectively before long cool, rainy spells (e.g. highland wet season).

**If you spray:** Protectants (mancozeb, chlorothalonil) before infection; for active outbreaks, products with cymoxanil, dimethomorph or metalaxyl-M combined with a protectant. Never rely on one product.

**Organic options:** Copper fungicides slow it but rarely stop an outbreak; removal of infected plants is essential.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** Report it to the MAO the same day - late blight affects the whole area.

_Check against: International Potato Center (CIP) - late blight management (cipotato.org); UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Vegetable MD Online - Cornell University (vegetablemdonline.ppath.cornell.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Tomato___Late_blight.tl:
**Late Blight sa Kamatis**

**Ano ito:** Water mould (Phytophthora infestans). Sobrang bilis kumalat kapag malamig at basa; kaya nitong patayin ang buong taniman sa ilang araw.

**Sintomas:** Malalaking batik na parang basa, grayish-green hanggang maitim; puting parang bulak sa ilalim ng dahon tuwing humid na umaga; matigas na brown na bulok sa bunga.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Gawin agad ngayon: bunutin at isako ang malalang tinamaang halaman - huwag i-compost.
2. Protektahan agad ng fungicide ang malulusog na halaman sa paligid.
3. Sabihan ang kalapit na taniman; tinatangay ng hangin ang spores.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Magtanim ng variety na matibay sa late blight kung mayroon.
2. Huwag magkatabi ang kamatis at patatas.
3. Mag-spray bilang proteksyon bago ang mahabang malamig at maulang panahon (hal. tag-ulan sa kabundukan).

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Protectant (mancozeb, chlorothalonil) bago pa tamaan; kapag kumakalat na, may cymoxanil, dimethomorph o metalaxyl-M na may kasamang protectant. Huwag umasa sa iisang produkto.

**Organic na paraan:** Napapabagal ito ng copper pero bihirang napapatigil; kailangang alisin ang may sakit na halaman.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** I-report sa MAO sa parehong araw - apektado ang buong lugar sa late blight.

_Sources: International Potato Center (CIP) - late blight management (cipotato.org); UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Vegetable MD Online - Cornell University (vegetablemdonline.ppath.cornell.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.en:
**Tomato Leaf Mold**

**What it is:** Fungus (Passalora fulva), favoured by high humidity, especially in greenhouses and dense planting.

**Signs:** Pale yellow patches on the top of the leaf with olive-green to brown velvety mould underneath.

**Do now:**
1. Open up the canopy: prune and remove the mouldy leaves.
2. Increase ventilation; avoid wetting leaves.

**Prevention:**
1. Wider spacing and staking.
2. Water early in the day at the base.
3. Resistant varieties where available.

**If you spray:** Chlorothalonil or mancozeb as protectants; some strobilurin products are labelled for it.

**Organic options:** Ventilation and pruning do most of the work; copper gives some protection.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** If it keeps spreading after improving airflow, ask the MAO.

_Check against: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Penn State Extension - vegetable and field crop disease fact sheets (extension.psu.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.tl:
**Amag sa Dahon ng Kamatis**

**Ano ito:** Fungus (Passalora fulva), lumalala sa sobrang humid na hangin, lalo na sa greenhouse at siksik na tanim.

**Sintomas:** Maputlang dilaw na batik sa ibabaw ng dahon at parang velvet na amag na olive-green hanggang brown sa ilalim.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Bawasan ang siksik: putulin ang inaamag na dahon.
2. Dagdagan ang hangin; huwag basain ang dahon.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Lakihan ang pagitan at lagyan ng tukod.
2. Magdilig sa umaga at sa puno.
3. Gumamit ng matibay na variety kung mayroon.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Chlorothalonil o mancozeb bilang proteksyon; may ilang strobilurin na nakalabel para dito.

**Organic na paraan:** Malaking tulong ang maaliwalas na hangin at pagputol ng sobrang dahon; may kaunting proteksyon ang copper.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** Kung kumakalat pa rin kahit maayos na ang hangin, magtanong sa MAO.

_Sources: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Penn State Extension - vegetable and field crop disease fact sheets (extension.psu.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.en:
**Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot**

**What it is:** Fungus (Septoria lycopersici), splashed up from soil and debris by rain.

**Signs:** Many small round spots with dark borders and pale grey centres, often with tiny black dots, on lower leaves first.

**Do now:**
1. Remove spotted lower leaves.
2. Mulch to stop soil splash.
3. Avoid working among wet plants.

**Prevention:**
1. Rotate 2-3 seasons away from tomato.
2. Clear and destroy crop debris.
3. Control solanaceous weeds.

**If you spray:** Protectant fungicides with mancozeb or chlorothalonil; systemic options include azoxystrobin or difenoconazole. Alternate groups so the fungus does not become resistant.

**Organic options:** Copper fungicides plus sanitation.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** If plants lose most lower leaves within two weeks, ask the MAO.

_Check against: Vegetable MD Online - Cornell University (vegetablemdonline.ppath.cornell.edu); Penn State Extension - vegetable and field crop disease fact sheets (extension.psu.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.tl:
**Septoria Leaf Spot sa Kamatis**

**Ano ito:** Fungus (Septoria lycopersici), tumatalsik mula sa lupa at tira ng halaman kapag umuulan.

**Sintomas:** Maraming maliliit at bilog na batik na may maitim na gilid at gray na gitna, minsan may maliliit na itim na tuldok, sa ibabang dahon muna.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Alisin ang may batik na dahon sa ibaba.
2. Mag-mulch para hindi tumalsik ang lupa.
3. Huwag galawin ang basang halaman.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Huwag magkamatis sa parehong lugar sa loob ng 2-3 season.
2. Linisin at itapon ang tira ng pananim.
3. Alisin ang mga damong kauri ng kamatis.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Fungicide na may mancozeb o chlorothalonil; may systemic din gaya ng azoxystrobin o difenoconazole. Magpalit-palit ng grupo para hindi masanay ang fungus.

**Organic na paraan:** Copper na fungicide kasama ang kalinisan.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** Kung nalagas ang karamihan ng ibabang dahon sa loob ng dalawang linggo, magtanong sa MAO.

_Sources: Vegetable MD Online - Cornell University (vegetablemdonline.ppath.cornell.edu); Penn State Extension - vegetable and field crop disease fact sheets (extension.psu.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.en:
**Tomato Spider Mites**

**What it is:** Not a disease: tiny two-spotted spider mites (Tetranychus urticae), worst in hot, dry weather.

**Signs:** Fine pale speckling on leaves, bronzing, and fine webbing under the leaves.

**Do now:**
1. Check the leaf underside with a magnifier to confirm mites.
2. Spray the undersides with a strong stream of water.
3. Remove heavily infested leaves.

**Prevention:**
1. Avoid drought stress and dusty conditions.
2. Avoid broad-spectrum insecticides - they kill the mites' natural enemies.

**If you spray:** Miticides (e.g. abamectin), rotated between different groups because mites become resistant quickly.

**Organic options:** Insecticidal soap or neem oil sprayed on leaf undersides, repeated per label.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** If webbing covers the tops of plants, ask the MAO.

_Check against: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.tl:
**Spider Mites sa Kamatis**

**Ano ito:** Hindi sakit: maliliit na hayop na spider mite (Tetranychus urticae), lumalala kapag mainit at tuyo.

**Sintomas:** Maliliit na puting tuldok-tuldok sa dahon, parang kinakalawang na kulay, at manipis na sapot sa ilalim ng dahon.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Silipin ang ilalim ng dahon gamit ang magnifier para makumpirma.
2. Spray-an ng malakas na tubig ang ilalim ng dahon.
3. Alisin ang dahong punô na ng mite.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Huwag hayaang matuyo ang halaman; iwasan ang maalikabok na paligid.
2. Iwasan ang insecticide na pumapatay ng lahat ng insekto - napapatay din nito ang kumakain sa mite.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Miticide (hal. abamectin), pinapalit-palit dahil mabilis masanay ang mite.

**Organic na paraan:** Insecticidal soap o neem oil sa ilalim ng dahon, inuulit ayon sa label.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** Kung may sapot na hanggang dulo ng halaman, magtanong sa MAO.

_Sources: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_

Tomato___Target_Spot.en:
**Tomato Target Spot**

**What it is:** Fungus (Corynespora cassiicola), favoured by warm, humid weather and dense canopies.

**Signs:** Brown spots with light centres and faint rings; can merge and blight whole leaves.

**Do now:**
1. Remove affected leaves.
2. Prune to open the canopy.

**Prevention:**
1. Rotate crops.
2. Destroy debris after harvest.
3. Avoid excess nitrogen that makes dense growth.

**If you spray:** Chlorothalonil, mancozeb or azoxystrobin-type fungicides, alternated.

**Organic options:** Sanitation and airflow; copper gives limited protection.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** If fruit starts to show sunken spots, ask the MAO.

_Check against: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Tomato___Target_Spot.tl:
**Target Spot sa Kamatis**

**Ano ito:** Fungus (Corynespora cassiicola), lumalala kapag mainit, humid at siksik ang tanim.

**Sintomas:** Brown na batik na maputi ang gitna at may malabong bilog; nagsasama-sama hanggang matuyo ang dahon.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Alisin ang apektadong dahon.
2. Putulin ang ilang dahon para lumuwag ang tanim.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Iba-ibahin ang itinatanim.
2. Itapon ang tira pagkatapos mag-ani.
3. Iwasan ang sobrang nitrogen na nagpapasiksik.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Chlorothalonil, mancozeb, o azoxystrobin, pinapalit-palit.

**Organic na paraan:** Kalinisan at maayos na hangin; may kaunting proteksyon ang copper.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** Kung nagkakaroon na ng lubog na batik ang bunga, magtanong sa MAO.

_Sources: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.en:
**Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus**

**What it is:** Virus (TYLCV) spread by whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci). There is no spray that cures it.

**Signs:** Small leaves curling upward with yellow edges, stunted plants, few flowers and fruit.

**Do now:**
1. Pull out and bag infected plants early - they keep feeding the whiteflies the virus.
2. Hang yellow sticky traps to monitor and reduce whiteflies.

**Prevention:**
1. Plant TYLCV-resistant varieties.
2. Raise seedlings under insect netting.
3. Keep a break between tomato crops and remove weeds that host whiteflies.

**If you spray:** Insecticides only reduce the whitefly carrier, not the virus; rotate groups and follow the label.

**Organic options:** Netting, sticky traps, neem or soap sprays against whiteflies.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** Report spreading outbreaks to the MAO; whitefly control works best area-wide.

_Check against: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Vegetable MD Online - Cornell University (vegetablemdonline.ppath.cornell.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.tl:
**Yellow Leaf Curl Virus sa Kamatis**

**Ano ito:** Virus (TYLCV) na dala ng whitefly (Bemisia tabaci). Walang spray na makakapagpagaling dito.

**Sintomas:** Maliliit na dahong kumukulot paitaas na may dilaw na gilid, halamang hindi lumalaki, kaunting bulaklak at bunga.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Bunutin at isako agad ang may sakit na halaman - dito kumukuha ng virus ang whitefly.
2. Magsabit ng dilaw na sticky trap para mabantayan at mabawasan ang whitefly.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Magtanim ng variety na matibay sa TYLCV.
2. Magpatubo ng punla sa loob ng insect net.
3. Magpahinga muna bago magtanim ulit ng kamatis, at alisin ang damong tinitirhan ng whitefly.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Ang insecticide ay pambawas lang sa whitefly, hindi gamot sa virus; magpalit-palit ng grupo at sundin ang label.

**Organic na paraan:** Net, sticky trap, at neem o sabon laban sa whitefly.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** I-report sa MAO kung kumakalat; mas epektibo kung sabay-sabay ang buong lugar sa pagkontrol ng whitefly.

_Sources: UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Vegetable MD Online - Cornell University (vegetablemdonline.ppath.cornell.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.en:
**Tomato Mosaic Virus**

**What it is:** Virus (ToMV) spread by touch - hands, tools, clothes - and by seed. Very stable; there is no cure.

**Signs:** Light and dark green mottling, distorted or fern-like leaves, uneven ripening of fruit.

**Do now:**
1. Remove and bag infected plants.
2. Wash hands with soap before touching other plants.
3. Disinfect pruning tools between plants.

**Prevention:**
1. Use certified seed and resistant varieties.
2. No smoking or tobacco handling near plants.
3. Handle healthy plants before suspect ones.

**When to get help:** Ask the MAO to confirm - mosaic symptoms can also come from other viruses.

_Check against: Vegetable MD Online - Cornell University (vegetablemdonline.ppath.cornell.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.tl:
**Mosaic Virus sa Kamatis**

**Ano ito:** Virus (ToMV) na kumakalat sa hawak - kamay, gamit, damit - at sa binhi. Matagal itong nabubuhay; walang gamot dito.

**Sintomas:** Halo-halong light at dark green na batik, baluktot o makitid na dahon, hindi pantay na paghinog ng bunga.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Alisin at isako ang may sakit na halaman.
2. Maghugas ng kamay ng sabon bago humawak ng ibang halaman.
3. Linisin ang panggupit bago lumipat ng halaman.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Gumamit ng certified na binhi at matibay na variety.
2. Bawal manigarilyo o humawak ng tabako malapit sa tanim.
3. Hawakan muna ang malulusog bago ang mukhang may sakit.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** Ipa-check sa MAO - may ibang virus na ganito rin ang itsura.

_Sources: Vegetable MD Online - Cornell University (vegetablemdonline.ppath.cornell.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_

Tomato___healthy.en:
**Tomato Healthy**

**What it is:** No disease seen on this leaf.

**Signs:** Even green colour, no spots, no curling.

**Do now:**
1. Keep checking a few plants every 2-3 days, especially after rain.
2. Photograph any leaf that changes and scan it again.

**Prevention:**
1. Water at the base, not over the leaves.
2. Keep the field weeded and spaced for air flow.
3. Rotate crops of different families each season.

**When to get help:** Not needed.

_Check against: Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Tomato___healthy.tl:
**Malusog na Kamatis**

**Ano ito:** Walang nakitang sakit sa dahong ito.

**Sintomas:** Pantay na berde, walang batik, hindi kulot.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Silipin ang ilang halaman tuwing 2-3 araw, lalo na pagkatapos umulan.
2. Kapag may dahong nag-iba ang itsura, picture-an at i-scan ulit.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Diligan sa puno, hindi sa dahon.
2. Laging alisin ang damo at bigyan ng pagitan ang mga tanim.
3. Iba-ibahin ang itinatanim bawat season.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** Hindi kailangan.

_Sources: Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.en:
**Pepper Bacterial Spot**

**What it is:** Bacteria (Xanthomonas species), carried on seed and spread by rain splash.

**Signs:** Small water-soaked spots that turn brown, yellowing and dropping leaves; raised spots on fruit.

**Do now:**
1. Remove spotted leaves and fallen leaves.
2. Avoid handling wet plants.

**Prevention:**
1. Certified seed and resistant varieties.
2. Rotate away from pepper and tomato for 2-3 seasons.
3. Drip or base watering.

**If you spray:** Copper bactericides, often with mancozeb, to protect new growth.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.tl:
**Bacterial Spot sa Sili**

Potato___Early_blight.en:
**Potato Early Blight**

**What it is:** Fungus (Alternaria solani), worst on older or stressed plants in warm, humid weather.

**Signs:** Dark brown spots with target-like rings on older leaves, often bordered by yellow.

**Do now:**
1. Remove the worst leaves.
2. Keep plants watered and fertilised to reduce stress.

**Prevention:**
1. Rotate away from potato, tomato and eggplant.
2. Remove volunteer potatoes and debris.

**If you spray:** Protectant fungicides with mancozeb or chlorothalonil; systemic options include azoxystrobin or difenoconazole. Alternate groups so the fungus does not become resistant.

**Organic options:** Copper and Bacillus-based products; good nutrition and rotation.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** If spots move onto the upper leaves before tubers bulk, ask the MAO.

Potato___Early_blight.tl:
**Early Blight sa Patatas**

**Ano ito:** Fungus (Alternaria solani), lumalala sa matanda o nanghihinang halaman kapag mainit at humid.

**Sintomas:** Dark brown na batik na parang target sa matatandang dahon, madalas may dilaw na gilid.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Alisin ang pinakamalalang dahon.
2. Diligan at lagyan ng tamang abono para hindi manghina.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Huwag magpatatas, magkamatis o magtalong sa parehong lugar.
2. Alisin ang mga sumibol na patatas at tira ng pananim.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Fungicide na may mancozeb o chlorothalonil; may systemic din gaya ng azoxystrobin o difenoconazole. Magpalit-palit ng grupo para hindi masanay ang fungus.

**Organic na paraan:** Copper at produktong may Bacillus; tamang abono at pag-iiba ng itinatanim.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

Potato___Late_blight.en:
**Potato Late Blight**

**What it is:** Water mould (Phytophthora infestans) - the disease behind the Irish famine. Spreads in days in cool, wet weather; tubers can rot in storage.

**Signs:** Dark, water-soaked patches, white mould on the underside in humid weather, blackened stems; reddish-brown rot inside tubers.

**Do now:**
1. Act today: remove and bag infected plants.
2. Spray the healthy part of the field to protect it.
3. Hill up soil over tubers so spores do not wash down to them.

**Prevention:**
1. Plant certified, disease-free seed tubers and resistant varieties.
2. Destroy cull piles and volunteers.
3. Spray protectively before cool, rainy spells.

**If you spray:** Protectants (mancozeb, chlorothalonil) before infection; cymoxanil, dimethomorph or metalaxyl-M mixtures once it is present. Alternate groups.

**Organic options:** Copper slows it; removal and resistant varieties are essential.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** Report to the MAO the same day.

_Check against: International Potato Center (CIP) - late blight management (cipotato.org); UC IPM Pest Management Guidelines - University of California (ipm.ucanr.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Potato___Late_blight.tl:
**Late Blight sa Patatas**

**Ano ito:** Water mould (Phytophthora infestans). Kumakalat sa loob ng ilang araw kapag malamig at basa; nabubulok din ang patatas kahit nakatago na.

**Sintomas:** Maitim at mukhang basa na batik, puting amag sa ilalim kapag humid, nangingitim na tangkay; mapula-pulang brown na bulok sa loob ng patatas.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Gawin agad ngayon: alisin at isako ang may sakit na halaman.
2. I-spray ang malusog na bahagi ng taniman bilang proteksyon.
3. Tabunan ng lupa ang puno para hindi madala ng tubig ang spores papunta sa patatas.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Gumamit ng certified na binhing patatas at matibay na variety.
2. Itapon ang tambak ng tinapong patatas at bunutin ang mga kusang sumibol.
3. Mag-spray bilang proteksyon bago ang malamig at maulang panahon.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Protectant (mancozeb, chlorothalonil) bago pa tamaan; halong may cymoxanil, dimethomorph o metalaxyl-M kapag mayroon na. Magpalit-palit ng grupo.

**Organic na paraan:** Napapabagal ng copper; kailangan ang pag-alis at matibay na variety.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** I-report sa MAO sa parehong araw.

Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.en:
**Corn Gray Leaf Spot**

**What it is:** Fungus (Cercospora zeae-maydis), surviving on corn residue; favoured by long humid, warm periods.

**Signs:** Long, narrow, rectangular grey to tan spots running between the leaf veins.

**Do now:**
1. Check how high on the plant it has reached; the leaves above the ear matter most for yield.

**Prevention:**
1. Plant tolerant hybrids.
2. Rotate away from corn for a season.
3. Bury or remove residue.

**If you spray:** Strobilurin and/or triazole fungicides around tasselling, if the disease is climbing toward the ear leaf.

**Organic options:** Rotation, residue management and tolerant hybrids.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** Ask the MAO whether a spray is worth it at your growth stage.

Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.tl:
**Gray Leaf Spot sa Mais**

**Ano ito:** Fungus (Cercospora zeae-maydis), nabubuhay sa tira ng mais; lumalala sa matagal na mainit at humid na panahon.

**Sintomas:** Mahahaba at makikitid na batik (parang rectangle), gray hanggang brown sa pagitan ng ugat ng dahon.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Tingnan kung gaano kataas na ang sakit; pinakamahalaga sa ani ang mga dahon sa itaas ng bunga.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Magtanim ng hybrid na matibay dito.
2. Huwag magmais sa parehong lugar sa loob ng isang season.
3. Ibaon o alisin ang tira.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Strobilurin at/o triazole na fungicide bandang paglabas ng bulaklak, kung umaakyat na papunta sa dahon ng bunga.

**Organic na paraan:** Pag-iiba ng itinatanim, paglilinis ng tira, at matibay na hybrid.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** Itanong sa MAO kung sulit pa ang pag-spray sa edad ng mais ninyo.

Corn___Common_rust.en:
**Corn Common Rust**

**What it is:** Fungus (Puccinia sorghi), blown in by wind; favoured by cool nights and dew.

**Signs:** Small, raised, cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both sides of the leaf.

**Do now:**
1. Usually no action on field corn if it appears late; watch the leaves above the ear.

**Prevention:**
1. Plant resistant hybrids.
2. Avoid very late planting when rust pressure is high.

**If you spray:** Triazole or strobilurin fungicides, mainly for sweet corn or susceptible hybrids with early, heavy infection.

**Organic options:** Resistant hybrids are the main tool.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** If pustules cover most of the upper leaves before tasselling, ask the MAO.

_Check against: CIMMYT Maize Doctor / maize disease field guide (maizedoctor.org); Penn State Extension - vegetable and field crop disease fact sheets (extension.psu.edu); Your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) / DA Regional Field Office / BPI_
Corn___Common_rust.tl:
**Common Rust sa Mais**

**Ano ito:** Fungus (Puccinia sorghi), tinatangay ng hangin; lumalala sa malamig na gabi at hamog.

**Sintomas:** Maliliit, nakaumbok, at parang pulbos na kulay-kalawang na butlig sa harap at likod ng dahon.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Kadalasan walang kailangang gawin kung huli na lumabas; bantayan ang mga dahon sa itaas ng bunga.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Magtanim ng matibay na hybrid.
2. Huwag masyadong magpahuli ng tanim kapag maraming rust sa lugar.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Triazole o strobilurin, lalo na sa sweet corn o mahinang hybrid na maaga at malala ang tama.

**Organic na paraan:** Matibay na hybrid ang pinakamabisang paraan.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

**Kailan magtatanong sa MAO:** Kung puno na ng butlig ang itaas na dahon bago lumabas ang bulaklak, magtanong sa MAO.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.en:
**Corn Northern Leaf Blight**

**What it is:** Fungus (Exserohilum turcicum), surviving on residue; favoured by moderate temperatures and long dew periods.

**Signs:** Long, cigar-shaped grey-green to tan lesions, several centimetres long.

**Do now:**
1. Check whether lesions are on the ear leaf or above before deciding on a spray.

**Prevention:**
1. Resistant hybrids.
2. Rotation and residue management.

**If you spray:** Strobilurin and/or triazole fungicides around tasselling when lesions reach the ear leaf on susceptible hybrids.

**Organic options:** Rotation, residue management and resistant hybrids.

⚠️ Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.

**When to get help:** Ask the MAO whether a spray pays at your stage.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.tl:
**Northern Leaf Blight sa Mais**

**Ano ito:** Fungus (Exserohilum turcicum), nabubuhay sa tira; lumalala sa hindi masyadong mainit at matagal na hamog.

**Sintomas:** Mahahaba at hugis-tabakong batik na grayish-green hanggang brown, ilang sentimetro ang haba.

**Gawin ngayon:**
1. Tingnan kung nasa dahon ng bunga o mas itaas na ang batik bago magpasya mag-spray.

**Para maiwasan:**
1. Matibay na hybrid.
2. Pag-iiba ng itinatanim at paglilinis ng tira.

**Kung mag-i-spray:** Strobilurin at/o triazole bandang paglabas ng bulaklak kapag umabot na sa dahon ng bunga sa mahinang hybrid.

**Organic na paraan:** Pag-iiba ng tanim, paglilinis ng tira, at matibay na hybrid.

⚠️ FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

cause.en: Fungus (Passalora fulva), favoured by high humidity, especially in greenhouses and dense planting.
cause.tl: Fungus (Passalora fulva), lumalala sa sobrang humid na hangin, lalo na sa greenhouse at siksik na tanim.

signs.en: Pale yellow patches on the top of the leaf with olive-green to brown velvety mould underneath.
signs.tl: Maputlang dilaw na batik sa ibabaw ng dahon at parang velvet na amag na olive-green hanggang brown sa ilalim.

en: Open up the canopy: prune and remove the mouldy leaves.
Increase ventilation; avoid wetting leaves.
tl: Bawasan ang siksik: putulin ang inaamag na dahon.
Dagdagan ang hangin; huwag basain ang dahon.

en: Wider spacing and staking.
Water early in the day at the base.
Resistant varieties where available.
tl: Lakihan ang pagitan at lagyan ng tukod.
Magdilig sa umaga at sa puno.
Gumamit ng matibay na variety kung mayroon.

chemical.en: Chlorothalonil or mancozeb as protectants; some strobilurin products are labelled for it.
chemical.tl: Chlorothalonil o mancozeb bilang proteksyon; may ilang strobilurin na nakalabel para dito.

organic.en: Ventilation and pruning do most of the work; copper gives some protection.
organic.tl: Malaking tulong ang maaliwalas na hangin at pagputol ng sobrang dahon; may kaunting proteksyon ang copper.

escalate.en: If it keeps spreading after improving airflow, ask the MAO.
escalate.tl: Kung kumakalat pa rin kahit maayos na ang hangin, magtanong sa MAO.

cause.en: Fungus (Septoria lycopersici), splashed up from soil and debris by rain.
cause.tl: Fungus (Septoria lycopersici), tumatalsik mula sa lupa at tira ng halaman kapag umuulan.

signs.en: Many small round spots with dark borders and pale grey centres, often with tiny black dots, on lower leaves first.
signs.tl: Maraming maliliit at bilog na batik na may maitim na gilid at gray na gitna, minsan may maliliit na itim na tuldok, sa ibabang dahon muna.

en: Remove spotted lower leaves.
Mulch to stop soil splash.
Avoid working among wet plants.
tl: Alisin ang may batik na dahon sa ibaba.
Mag-mulch para hindi tumalsik ang lupa.
Huwag galawin ang basang halaman.

en: Rotate 2-3 seasons away from tomato.
Clear and destroy crop debris.
Control solanaceous weeds.
tl: Huwag magkamatis sa parehong lugar sa loob ng 2-3 season.
Linisin at itapon ang tira ng pananim.
Alisin ang mga damong kauri ng kamatis.

chemical.en: Protectant fungicides with mancozeb or chlorothalonil; systemic options include azoxystrobin or difenoconazole. Alternate groups so the fungus does not become resistant.
chemical.tl: Fungicide na may mancozeb o chlorothalonil; may systemic din gaya ng azoxystrobin o difenoconazole. Magpalit-palit ng grupo para hindi masanay ang fungus.

organic.tl: Copper na fungicide kasama ang kalinisan.

escalate.en: If plants lose most lower leaves within two weeks, ask the MAO.
escalate.tl: Kung nalagas ang karamihan ng ibabang dahon sa loob ng dalawang linggo, magtanong sa MAO.

cause.en: Not a disease: tiny two-spotted spider mites (Tetranychus urticae), worst in hot, dry weather.
cause.tl: Hindi sakit: maliliit na hayop na spider mite (Tetranychus urticae), lumalala kapag mainit at tuyo.

signs.en: Fine pale speckling on leaves, bronzing, and fine webbing under the leaves.
signs.tl: Maliliit na puting tuldok-tuldok sa dahon, parang kinakalawang na kulay, at manipis na sapot sa ilalim ng dahon.

en: Check the leaf underside with a magnifier to confirm mites.
Spray the undersides with a strong stream of water.
Remove heavily infested leaves.
tl: Silipin ang ilalim ng dahon gamit ang magnifier para makumpirma.
Spray-an ng malakas na tubig ang ilalim ng dahon.
Alisin ang dahong punô na ng mite.

en: Avoid drought stress and dusty conditions.
Avoid broad-spectrum insecticides - they kill the mites' natural enemies.
tl: Huwag hayaang matuyo ang halaman; iwasan ang maalikabok na paligid.
Iwasan ang insecticide na pumapatay ng lahat ng insekto - napapatay din nito ang kumakain sa mite.

chemical.en: Miticides (e.g. abamectin), rotated between different groups because mites become resistant quickly.
chemical.tl: Miticide (hal. abamectin), pinapalit-palit dahil mabilis masanay ang mite.

organic.en: Insecticidal soap or neem oil sprayed on leaf undersides, repeated per label.
organic.tl: Insecticidal soap o neem oil sa ilalim ng dahon, inuulit ayon sa label.

escalate.en: If webbing covers the tops of plants, ask the MAO.
escalate.tl: Kung may sapot na hanggang dulo ng halaman, magtanong sa MAO.

cause.en: Fungus (Corynespora cassiicola), favoured by warm, humid weather and dense canopies.
cause.tl: Fungus (Corynespora cassiicola), lumalala kapag mainit, humid at siksik ang tanim.

signs.en: Brown spots with light centres and faint rings; can merge and blight whole leaves.
signs.tl: Brown na batik na maputi ang gitna at may malabong bilog; nagsasama-sama hanggang matuyo ang dahon.

en: Remove affected leaves.
Prune to open the canopy.
tl: Alisin ang apektadong dahon.
Putulin ang ilang dahon para lumuwag ang tanim.

en: Rotate crops.
Destroy debris after harvest.
Avoid excess nitrogen that makes dense growth.
tl: Iba-ibahin ang itinatanim.
Itapon ang tira pagkatapos mag-ani.
Iwasan ang sobrang nitrogen na nagpapasiksik.

chemical.en: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb or azoxystrobin-type fungicides, alternated.

organic.en: Sanitation and airflow; copper gives limited protection.
organic.tl: Kalinisan at maayos na hangin; may kaunting proteksyon ang copper.

escalate.en: If fruit starts to show sunken spots, ask the MAO.
escalate.tl: Kung nagkakaroon na ng lubog na batik ang bunga, magtanong sa MAO.

cause.en: Virus (TYLCV) spread by whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci). There is no spray that cures it.
cause.tl: Virus (TYLCV) na dala ng whitefly (Bemisia tabaci). Walang spray na makakapagpagaling dito.

signs.en: Small leaves curling upward with yellow edges, stunted plants, few flowers and fruit.
signs.tl: Maliliit na dahong kumukulot paitaas na may dilaw na gilid, halamang hindi lumalaki, kaunting bulaklak at bunga.

en: Pull out and bag infected plants early - they keep feeding the whiteflies the virus.
Hang yellow sticky traps to monitor and reduce whiteflies.
tl: Bunutin at isako agad ang may sakit na halaman - dito kumukuha ng virus ang whitefly.
Magsabit ng dilaw na sticky trap para mabantayan at mabawasan ang whitefly.

en: Plant TYLCV-resistant varieties.
Raise seedlings under insect netting.
Keep a break between tomato crops and remove weeds that host whiteflies.
tl: Magtanim ng variety na matibay sa TYLCV.
Magpatubo ng punla sa loob ng insect net.
Magpahinga muna bago magtanim ulit ng kamatis, at alisin ang damong tinitirhan ng whitefly.

chemical.en: Insecticides only reduce the whitefly carrier, not the virus; rotate groups and follow the label.
chemical.tl: Ang insecticide ay pambawas lang sa whitefly, hindi gamot sa virus; magpalit-palit ng grupo at sundin ang label.

organic.en: Netting, sticky traps, neem or soap sprays against whiteflies.
organic.tl: Net, sticky trap, at neem o sabon laban sa whitefly.

escalate.en: Report spreading outbreaks to the MAO; whitefly control works best area-wide.
escalate.tl: I-report sa MAO kung kumakalat; mas epektibo kung sabay-sabay ang buong lugar sa pagkontrol ng whitefly.

cause.en: Virus (ToMV) spread by touch - hands, tools, clothes - and by seed. Very stable; there is no cure.
cause.tl: Virus (ToMV) na kumakalat sa hawak - kamay, gamit, damit - at sa binhi. Matagal itong nabubuhay; walang gamot dito.

signs.en: Light and dark green mottling, distorted or fern-like leaves, uneven ripening of fruit.
signs.tl: Halo-halong light at dark green na batik, baluktot o makitid na dahon, hindi pantay na paghinog ng bunga.

en: Remove and bag infected plants.
Wash hands with soap before touching other plants.
Disinfect pruning tools between plants.
tl: Alisin at isako ang may sakit na halaman.
Maghugas ng kamay ng sabon bago humawak ng ibang halaman.
Linisin ang panggupit bago lumipat ng halaman.

en: Use certified seed and resistant varieties.
No smoking or tobacco handling near plants.
Handle healthy plants before suspect ones.
tl: Gumamit ng certified na binhi at matibay na variety.
Bawal manigarilyo o humawak ng tabako malapit sa tanim.
Hawakan muna ang malulusog bago ang mukhang may sakit.

escalate.en: Ask the MAO to confirm - mosaic symptoms can also come from other viruses.
escalate.tl: Ipa-check sa MAO - may ibang virus na ganito rin ang itsura.

cause.tl: Walang nakitang sakit sa dahong ito.

signs.en: Even green colour, no spots, no curling.
signs.tl: Pantay na berde, walang batik, hindi kulot.

en: Keep checking a few plants every 2-3 days, especially after rain.
Photograph any leaf that changes and scan it again.
tl: Silipin ang ilang halaman tuwing 2-3 araw, lalo na pagkatapos umulan.
Kapag may dahong nag-iba ang itsura, picture-an at i-scan ulit.

en: Water at the base, not over the leaves.
Keep the field weeded and spaced for air flow.
Rotate crops of different families each season.
tl: Diligan sa puno, hindi sa dahon.
Laging alisin ang damo at bigyan ng pagitan ang mga tanim.
Iba-ibahin ang itinatanim bawat season.

cause.en: Bacteria (Xanthomonas species), carried on seed and spread by rain splash.
cause.tl: Bacteria (Xanthomonas), dala ng binhi at kumakalat sa talsik ng ulan.

signs.en: Small water-soaked spots that turn brown, yellowing and dropping leaves; raised spots on fruit.
signs.tl: Maliliit na mukhang basa na batik na nagiging brown, naninilaw at nalalagas na dahon; nakaumbok na batik sa bunga.

en: Remove spotted leaves and fallen leaves.
Avoid handling wet plants.
tl: Alisin ang may batik at nalagas na dahon.
Huwag hawakan ang basang halaman.

en: Certified seed and resistant varieties.
Rotate away from pepper and tomato for 2-3 seasons.
Drip or base watering.
tl: Certified na binhi at matibay na variety.
Huwag magsili o magkamatis sa parehong lugar sa loob ng 2-3 season.
Magdilig sa puno.

chemical.en: Copper bactericides, often with mancozeb, to protect new growth.
chemical.tl: Copper na bactericide, madalas may mancozeb, para protektahan ang bagong dahon.

organic.tl: Copper na pang-organic kasama ang kalinisan.

escalate.en: If leaf drop is heavy, bring a sample to the MAO.
escalate.tl: Kung marami nang nalalagas na dahon, magdala ng sample sa MAO.

cause.en: Fungus (Alternaria solani), worst on older or stressed plants in warm, humid weather.
cause.tl: Fungus (Alternaria solani), lumalala sa matanda o nanghihinang halaman kapag mainit at humid.

signs.en: Dark brown spots with target-like rings on older leaves, often bordered by yellow.
signs.tl: Dark brown na batik na parang target sa matatandang dahon, madalas may dilaw na gilid.

en: Remove the worst leaves.
Keep plants watered and fertilised to reduce stress.
tl: Alisin ang pinakamalalang dahon.
Diligan at lagyan ng tamang abono para hindi manghina.

en: Rotate away from potato, tomato and eggplant.
Remove volunteer potatoes and debris.
tl: Huwag magpatatas, magkamatis o magtalong sa parehong lugar.
Alisin ang mga sumibol na patatas at tira ng pananim.

chemical.en: Protectant fungicides with mancozeb or chlorothalonil; systemic options include azoxystrobin or difenoconazole. Alternate groups so the fungus does not become resistant.
chemical.tl: Fungicide na may mancozeb o chlorothalonil; may systemic din gaya ng azoxystrobin o difenoconazole. Magpalit-palit ng grupo para hindi masanay ang fungus.

organic.en: Copper and Bacillus-based products; good nutrition and rotation.
organic.tl: Copper at produktong may Bacillus; tamang abono at pag-iiba ng itinatanim.

escalate.en: If spots move onto the upper leaves before tubers bulk, ask the MAO.
escalate.tl: Kung umaakyat na sa itaas na dahon bago lumaki ang patatas, magtanong sa MAO.

cause.en: Water mould (Phytophthora infestans) - the disease behind the Irish famine. Spreads in days in cool, wet weather; tubers can rot in storage.
cause.tl: Water mould (Phytophthora infestans). Kumakalat sa loob ng ilang araw kapag malamig at basa; nabubulok din ang patatas kahit nakatago na.

signs.en: Dark, water-soaked patches, white mould on the underside in humid weather, blackened stems; reddish-brown rot inside tubers.
signs.tl: Maitim at mukhang basa na batik, puting amag sa ilalim kapag humid, nangingitim na tangkay; mapula-pulang brown na bulok sa loob ng patatas.

en: Act today: remove and bag infected plants.
Spray the healthy part of the field to protect it.
Hill up soil over tubers so spores do not wash down to them.
tl: Gawin agad ngayon: alisin at isako ang may sakit na halaman.
I-spray ang malusog na bahagi ng taniman bilang proteksyon.
Tabunan ng lupa ang puno para hindi madala ng tubig ang spores papunta sa patatas.

en: Plant certified, disease-free seed tubers and resistant varieties.
Destroy cull piles and volunteers.
Spray protectively before cool, rainy spells.
tl: Gumamit ng certified na binhing patatas at matibay na variety.
Itapon ang tambak ng tinapong patatas at bunutin ang mga kusang sumibol.
Mag-spray bilang proteksyon bago ang malamig at maulang panahon.

chemical.en: Protectants (mancozeb, chlorothalonil) before infection; cymoxanil, dimethomorph or metalaxyl-M mixtures once it is present. Alternate groups.
chemical.tl: Protectant (mancozeb, chlorothalonil) bago pa tamaan; halong may cymoxanil, dimethomorph o metalaxyl-M kapag mayroon na. Magpalit-palit ng grupo.

organic.en: Copper slows it; removal and resistant varieties are essential.
organic.tl: Napapabagal ng copper; kailangan ang pag-alis at matibay na variety.

escalate.tl: I-report sa MAO sa parehong araw.

cause.en: Fungus (Cercospora zeae-maydis), surviving on corn residue; favoured by long humid, warm periods.
cause.tl: Fungus (Cercospora zeae-maydis), nabubuhay sa tira ng mais; lumalala sa matagal na mainit at humid na panahon.

signs.en: Long, narrow, rectangular grey to tan spots running between the leaf veins.
signs.tl: Mahahaba at makikitid na batik (parang rectangle), gray hanggang brown sa pagitan ng ugat ng dahon.

en: Check how high on the plant it has reached; the leaves above the ear matter most for yield.
tl: Tingnan kung gaano kataas na ang sakit; pinakamahalaga sa ani ang mga dahon sa itaas ng bunga.

en: Plant tolerant hybrids.
Rotate away from corn for a season.
Bury or remove residue.
tl: Magtanim ng hybrid na matibay dito.
Huwag magmais sa parehong lugar sa loob ng isang season.
Ibaon o alisin ang tira.

chemical.en: Strobilurin and/or triazole fungicides around tasselling, if the disease is climbing toward the ear leaf.
chemical.tl: Strobilurin at/o triazole na fungicide bandang paglabas ng bulaklak, kung umaakyat na papunta sa dahon ng bunga.

organic.en: Rotation, residue management and tolerant hybrids.
organic.tl: Pag-iiba ng itinatanim, paglilinis ng tira, at matibay na hybrid.

escalate.en: Ask the MAO whether a spray is worth it at your growth stage.
escalate.tl: Itanong sa MAO kung sulit pa ang pag-spray sa edad ng mais ninyo.

cause.tl: Fungus (Puccinia sorghi), tinatangay ng hangin; lumalala sa malamig na gabi at hamog.

signs.en: Small, raised, cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both sides of the leaf.
signs.tl: Maliliit, nakaumbok, at parang pulbos na kulay-kalawang na butlig sa harap at likod ng dahon.

en: Usually no action on field corn if it appears late; watch the leaves above the ear.
tl: Kadalasan walang kailangang gawin kung huli na lumabas; bantayan ang mga dahon sa itaas ng bunga.

en: Plant resistant hybrids.
Avoid very late planting when rust pressure is high.
tl: Magtanim ng matibay na hybrid.
Huwag masyadong magpahuli ng tanim kapag maraming rust sa lugar.

chemical.en: Triazole or strobilurin fungicides, mainly for sweet corn or susceptible hybrids with early, heavy infection.
chemical.tl: Triazole o strobilurin, lalo na sa sweet corn o mahinang hybrid na maaga at malala ang tama.

organic.en: Resistant hybrids are the main tool.
organic.tl: Matibay na hybrid ang pinakamabisang paraan.

escalate.en: If pustules cover most of the upper leaves before tasselling, ask the MAO.
escalate.tl: Kung puno na ng butlig ang itaas na dahon bago lumabas ang bulaklak, magtanong sa MAO.

signs.en: Long, cigar-shaped grey-green to tan lesions, several centimetres long.
signs.tl: Mahahaba at hugis-tabakong batik na grayish-green hanggang brown, ilang sentimetro ang haba.

en: Check whether lesions are on the ear leaf or above before deciding on a spray.

en: Resistant hybrids.

label_rule.en: Use only FPA-registered products. Follow the label for dose, spray interval, protective gear and the days to wait before harvest.
label_rule.tl: FPA-registered na produkto lang ang gamitin. Sundin ang label: gaano karami, gaano kadalas mag-spray, anong proteksyon sa katawan, at ilang araw bago mag-ani.

harvest_rule.en: Do not sell or eat fruit or tubers that show spots, rot or mould - remove them. Healthy-looking produce from sprayed plants may be harvested only after the waiting period on the product label (pre-harvest interval). Wash produce before eating.
harvest_rule.tl: Huwag ibenta o kainin ang bunga o patatas na may batik, bulok o amag - itapon ang mga iyon. Kung na-spray-an ang halaman, puwede lang anihin ang maayos na bunga pagkalipas ng ilang araw na nakasulat sa label (pre-harvest interval). Hugasan bago kainin.

dont_know.tl: Hindi ko iyan masasagot nang sigurado mula sa gabay ng SIPAT. Basahin ang gabay sa itaas at magtanong sa Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO).
